# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src.agents.iterative_tdd_runner | Orchestrates the iterative RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | src.agents.tdd_cycle_runner | Executes one complete RED→GREEN→REFACTOR cycle with retries and learning |
| IncrementalPlanner | src.agents.incremental_planner | Determines the next test increment using LLM and current context |
| PythonLanguagePod | src.agents.python_language_pod | Implements LanguagePod for Python: code generation and isolated execution |
| WorkerAgent | src.agents.worker_agent | Generates test, implementation, and refactoring code via LLM |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src.agents.podman_orchestrator | Stateless sidecar for pulse-based container execution with security verification |
| PodmanRunner | src.agents.podman_runner | Manages rootless Podman container lifecycle and file pulses |
| PlaybookManager | src.playbook.manager | Creates, retrieves, and updates playbooks; manages bullet lifecycle |
| BulletRetriever | src.playbook.retrieval | Hybrid retrieval (keyword + embedding) for relevant playbook bullets |
| DistillationRouter | src.playbook.distillation_router | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src.retrieval.service | Central knowledge retrieval service for code generation guidance |
| ContextGraphRetriever | src.retrieval.cgr3_retriever | Context-aware retrieve-rank-reason pipeline (CGR³) |
| ContextScorer | src.retrieval.context_scorer | Scores bullets against request context (temporal, team, project) |
| Generator | src.core.generator.module | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation |
| Reflector | src.core.reflector.module | Analyzes task outcomes and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | src.core.curator.module | Synthesizes reflector insights into playbook delta updates |
| ExperimentLogger | src.storage.experiment_logger | Persists TDD cycles and ML experiments to PostgreSQL/SQLite |
| TokenEfficiencyReporter | src.analytics.token_efficiency | Aggregates token usage from language pods and computes efficiency scores |
| SuccessRateCalculator | src.analytics.success_rate_calculator | Measures experiment success rates across types and versions |
| CostQualityAnalyzer | src.analytics.cost_quality_analyzer | Analyzes cost-quality tradeoffs and computes Pareto frontiers |
| TestReviewAgent | src.agents.test_review_agent | Validates test quality (structure, assertions, edge cases) |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src.agents.redundancy_checker | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy before RED phase |
| TDDFailureRecorder | src.agents.tdd_failure_recorder | Records TDD failures with context for self-healing |
| TDDLessonInjector | src.agents.tdd_lesson_injector | Injects learned TDD lessons into prompts per phase |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src.agents.gherkin_feature_bridge | Parses .feature files into FeatureSpec for requirement extraction |
| GherkinExtractionAgent | src.agents.gherkin_extraction_agent | Reverse-engineers Gherkin scenarios from existing code and tests |
| EnsembleLearner | src.ensemble.learner | Orchestrates multi-model learning, voting, and consensus |
| AdaptiveBroker | src.broker.adaptive_broker | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| PerformanceAggregator | src.broker.performance_aggregator | Aggregates agent metrics from audit trail for broker decisions |
| ContractArchitect | src.contracts.contract_architect | Generates interface contracts from natural language requirements |
| ContractDecomposer | src.contracts.contract_decomposer | Decomposes specs into structured interface contracts |
| ModuleArchitect | src.contracts.module_architect | Generates module-level contracts for stateful systems |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as User
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orch as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant PB as PlaybookManager
    participant Gen as Generator
    participant Ref as Reflector
    participant Cur as Curator

    User ->> Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    activate Runner
    Runner ->> Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle_number)
    activate Planner
    Planner -->> Runner: PodSpec
    deactivate Planner
    loop for each cycle (max max_iterations)
        Runner ->> Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle
        Cycle ->> Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod ->> Worker: generate_test(spec)
        activate Worker
        Worker -->> Pod: test_code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod ->> Orch: pulse({test_file: test_code})
        activate Orch
        Orch ->> Container: send_pulse(files)
        activate Container
        Container -->> Orch: PulseResult
        deactivate Container
        Orch -->> Pod: PhaseResult (passed=false)
        deactivate Orch
        Pod -->> Cycle: red_result
        deactivate Pod
        Note right of Cycle: GREEN with retries
        loop max_green_attempts
            Cycle ->> Pod: run_green(spec_error)
            activate Pod
            Pod ->> Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_output)
            activate Worker
            Worker -->> Pod: impl_code
            deactivate Worker
            Pod ->> Orch: pulse({test, impl})
            activate Orch
            Orch ->> Container: send_pulse(files)
            activate Container
            Container -->> Orch: PulseResult
            deactivate Container
            Orch -->> Pod: PhaseResult
            deactivate Orch
            Pod -->> Cycle: green_result
            deactivate Pod
            alt green passed
                break if passed
            else
                Cycle ->> Cycle: update error_feedback
            end
        end
        alt green passed
            Cycle ->> Pod: run_refactor(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod ->> Orch: pulse({test, impl})
            activate Orch
            Orch ->> Container: send_pulse(files)
            activate Container
            Container -->> Orch: PulseResult
            deactivate Container
            Orch -->> Pod: PhaseResult
            deactivate Orch
            Pod -->> Cycle: refactor_result
            deactivate Pod
            opt learning enabled
                Cycle ->> Ref: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                activate Ref
                Ref -->> Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                deactivate Ref
                Cycle ->> Cur: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                activate Cur
                Cur ->> PB: apply_delta(delta_bullets)
                activate PB
                PB -->> Cur: added_bullets
                deactivate PB
                Cur -->> Cycle: CuratorOutput
                deactivate Cur
            end
        end
        Cycle -->> Runner: CycleResult
        deactivate Cycle
        alt planner says COMPLETE
            break
        end
    end
    Runner -->> User: IterativeResult
    deactivate Runner
```
